# Capability-group config (v1)

Schema for `.tera/capability-groups/<name>.hcl` config files. Each decodes to `pkg/config.CapabilityGroupBlock`, a named set of member capabilities — the substrate a virtual MCP server (ADR-062 §2) is synthesized from. The block label is the group name.

A member is named by capability name, and may be any tool the deployment can reach: a **locally declared tool** (a sandboxed tool extension, ADR-061) or a **tool of a fronted MCP upstream**, named `<upstreamID>.<tool>` once that upstream projects its catalog into the capability registry (ADR-070 §3; projection is on by default per §4). Composing remote and local members in one group is the point: the resulting virtual server presents them to every client as one MCP server, and a call to a projected member forwards through the same managed upstream connection the gateway's own exposures use — same failover, same far-side credentials.

| | |
|---|---|
| Registry name | `config/capability-groups` |
| Regime | persisted |
| Identity regime | `inventory` — the block label is the identity; the file is a container and its stem carries no meaning (ADR-087 D3) |
| Current version | `v1` |
| Supported versions | `v1` |
| HCL block | `capability_group` |
| Loader directory | `.tera/capability-groups/<name>.hcl` |
| Go source | `github.com/kottera/kottera/pkg/config.CapabilityGroupBlock` |
| Served at | `GET /api/v1/schemas/config/capability-groups/reference` |

## Example

A minimal `capability-groups`: every required attribute, exactly one member of each closed union, and nothing optional beyond what the kind would otherwise render empty. It is generated from the same source these tables are, and the same bytes are run through `tera validate` by the ADR-087 D9 pattern-transfer test — so it cannot describe a shape the loader does not accept.

Cross-references name the other kinds' examples (`example-worker`, `example-tool`, …) because every kind's example is validated together with the rest, as one vault.

`.tera/capability-groups/example-capability-group.hcl`:

```hcl
version = "v1"

capability_group "example-capability-group" {
  type    = "tools"
  members = ["example-tool"]
}
```
